review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role is ideal for a security professional who combines strong technical expertise, SOC/Security Operations experience, and leadership capabilities , with the ability to support the organization’s security strategy, governance, and compliance requirements. Key Responsibilities: • Lead day-to-day Information Security and SOC operations • Oversee security monitoring, incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management • Manage and optimize security technologies including SIEM, Firewalls, EDR, DLP, and Email Security solutions • Lead incident containment, root cause analysis, recovery, and post-incident reviews • Manage vulnerability assessments and support/lead penetration testing activities • Support threat hunting, threat intelligence, and proactive identification of security risks • Ensure effective implementation of Information Security policies, controls, and access
